body: Pass 1 of the standing audio task pushed at 7f62b4e. FightAudio autoload: Master/SFX/Crowd/Music buses, four synthetic impact sounds (punch_head, punch_body, block, miss) generated from raw PCM at startup - zero purchased audio. Both fight screens call FightAudio.on_beat() after advance_beat(): landed head strikes go high-frequency, body shots go low-frequency thud, misses go whoosh, high-grade grapples go body impact. 43/0 test, smoke 0 failures. What is still wrong: (1) sounds are sine+noise synthesis, not real fight Foley - they READ as impacts but do not yet SOUND like gloves on flesh; (2) no variant randomisation beyond pitch/volume jitter, so repeated head shots still share a fingerprint; (3) blocked strikes have a sound wired but the beat router does not yet distinguish blocked from missed (both go to miss); (4) crowd bed, breath, canvas, bell - passes 2-4 of the standing objective - are not started. Gate: parse + fight_audio_test + fight_world_live_test + smoke, all green.
